Daily Devotional

September 27

10 Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom. (Proverbs 13:10 KJV)

Contention is the beginning of strife, and the Word tells us that where strife and envying are, there is every evil work by the devil (James 3:16). The Christian should be very careful to not ever get into contention or strife, as it will let the devil have unlimited access to you, and bring all kinds of problems into your life. Remember that the devil only comes to steal, kill and destroy (John 10:10).

Note that all contention and strife come from pride, and only by pride. Remember that pride is not just arrogance, but is any form of being self-centered, which can be thinking you are better than others, or being shy is another form of pride. Any time you are self-centered, or thinking only of yourself, then you are exhibiting pride. If you follow what Jesus taught of thinking more of others than you do of yourself, then you will stay away from pride. Notice that being well advised is wisdom, and wisdom and understanding are two attributes that the Word says we should seek after (Proverbs 4:7). I believe it is telling us that those that are always into strife are not too bright. Thank you Lord for your directions.
